title: After the change
subtitle: New CVEs since 15 April 2026 by NVD status, and how fast the NVD analyzes the ones in KEV

plan.title: After the change
plan.estimator: counts by NVD status; share analyzed; share of analyzed that are in KEV; hours from KEV listing to NVD analysis
plan.prediction: most analyzed CVEs since the change are KEV listed or critical software
plan.interval: cluster bootstrap by filer, 2000 resamples, 95 percent

window: the shadow window, from 2026-04-15 to the data cut
interval: cluster bootstrap by filer, 2000 resamples, 95 percent

rejected.population: CVEs published since 2026-04-15 and since rejected

status_deferred.population: CVEs published since 2026-04-15 with NVD status Deferred

status_analyzed.population: CVEs published since 2026-04-15 with NVD status Analyzed

status_awaiting_analysis.population: CVEs published since 2026-04-15 with NVD status Awaiting Analysis

status_modified.population: CVEs published since 2026-04-15 with NVD status Modified

status_received.population: CVEs published since 2026-04-15 with NVD status Received

status_rejected.population: CVEs published since 2026-04-15 with NVD status Rejected

status_undergoing_analysis.population: CVEs published since 2026-04-15 with NVD status Undergoing Analysis

status_none.population: CVEs published since 2026-04-15 with NVD status None

share_analyzed.unit: share of CVEs the NVD analyzed

analyzed.population: CVEs published since 2026-04-15 the NVD analyzed

share_kev_among_analyzed.population: CVEs published since 2026-04-15 the NVD analyzed
share_kev_among_analyzed.unit: share of analyzed CVEs that are KEV listed

kev_listed.population: CVEs published since 2026-04-15 and listed in KEV

kev_analyzed_before_listing.population: KEV listed CVEs published since 2026-04-15 the NVD analyzed before the listing

kev_analyzed_after_listing.population: KEV listed CVEs published since 2026-04-15 with an NVD analysis event (initial, reanalysis or modified analysis) at or after the listing, including CVEs first analyzed before it

kev_not_analyzed.population: KEV listed CVEs published since 2026-04-15 with no NVD analysis by the cut

median_hours_listing_to_analysis.population: KEV listed CVEs published since 2026-04-15 analyzed at or after the listing
median_hours_listing_to_analysis.unit: hours from the KEV listing to the first NVD analysis

p90_hours_listing_to_analysis.population: KEV listed CVEs published since 2026-04-15 analyzed at or after the listing

share_met_one_business_day.population: KEV listed CVEs published since 2026-04-15 whose one business day has passed by the cut
share_met_one_business_day.unit: share analyzed within one business day of the listing (or before it)

by_status.population: CVEs published since 2026-04-15, by their NVD status at the data cut

listing_dated_by.population: KEV listed CVEs published since 2026-04-15, by the rule that dated the listing

prediction_check: Of the CVEs the NVD analyzed since the change, 0.005292245854965668 are KEV listed; the critical software part cannot be measured from the locked sources.
method: The status is the NVD vulnStatus at the data cut. A CVE counts as analyzed when the NVD change history shows an analysis event or its status is Analyzed or Modified. The hours run from the KEV listing (the first kev-data commit that carried it, which gives the hour, or the start of dateAdded when no commit falls on that day) to the first analysis event at or after it. Intervals are a cluster bootstrap by filer, 2,000 resamples, 95 percent.
sql:
-- Q2: CVEs published since 2026-04-15 by NVD status, and the KEV listed among them with the
-- hours from listing to the first NVD analysis at or after the listing.
select
    nvd_status,
    count(*) as cves,
    count(*) filter (where nvd_analyzed) as analyzed,
    count(*) filter (where kev_listed) as kev_listed,
    count(*) filter (where kev_listed and analyzed_before_listing) as kev_analyzed_before_listing,
    median(hours_listing_to_analysis) as median_hours_listing_to_analysis
from gold.mart_backlog_q2
group by nvd_status
order by cves desc

departure.reason: The prediction names KEV listed or critical software. No locked source says which software NIST counts as critical or as used by the federal government, so only the KEV share of the analyzed CVEs is measured.
